name: @geoquery/python
//: Façade so turbo can see the Python SDK as one node in the repo-wide task graph. It carries no dependencies — pixi owns the interpreter and the toolchain, and the editable install is done by `pixi run py-install` (a depends-on of the pixi `test`/`cov` tasks). Every script `cd ../..` to the repository root because the ruff `src` config, the pytest `testpaths`/`pythonpath` and the coverage output path are all resolved from there. The commands are the ones that used to be pixi's *-py tasks, verbatim.

scripts.lint: cd ../.. && ruff check python/geoquery && ruff format --check python/geoquery
scripts.fmt: cd ../.. && ruff check --fix python/geoquery && ruff format python/geoquery
scripts.dist: cd ../.. && rm -rf dist/pypi && mkdir -p dist/pypi && cd python/geoquery && hatchling build --directory ../../dist/pypi
